genericProblem: A package can report PASS when production controls, their self-tests, and the package-exit fact surface do not share an exact, fail-closed result denominator.

counterexamples.result: Four P0 required standards refs return zero; the failure is not a blanket standards runner failure.
P3-A capability-invariants remains explicitly NOT_READY and is outside P0 completion; no P3 claim is made.

findings.statement: The runner places multiple commands in an if-condition group, so a non-final failure can be hidden by a later success.
affected-l2 is production-red for 18 legacy missing targets and lacks the accepted RM2-expiring DEFERRED representation.
The P0 exit has no exact production status record for declared refs and the affected-l2 self-test prepared empty target paths.
The managed-run manifest used business PASS for standards-execution success while P0 business is not applicable.
The frozen historical-intake exact set remains intentionally immutable; P3-A and P4 skeleton states remain explicitly non-completion and are not advanced by this remediation.
